evidence.quote: Create scoped access tokens and send them as Bearer tokens.

description: Postgres-based backend platform; Management API controls orgs, projects, branches and config.

evidence.quote: All API requests require an access token to be included in the Authorization header
OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user
Start building for free, collaborate with your team, then scale to millions of users

name: Neo4j
entity_note: Interpreted as Neo4j Aura API (api.neo4j.io) for instance management; database data access is via per-instance Bolt/HTTP Query API endpoints.
description: Graph database; Aura API manages cloud instances, separate Bolt/Query API for data.
needs_human: Aura API manages instances only; data access is per-instance Bolt/Query API. Which surface should the toolkit target? Also confirm whether a hosted remote Neo4j MCP exists (only local server found).

evidence.quote: you must provide a Bearer Token in the Authorization header of each request
Authentication to the token endpoint uses HTTP Basic Authentication
(recommended, no credit card): https://neo4j.com/cloud/aura-free/
Neo4j MCP implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets applications connect to external data sources and tools.
The current version of the Aura API is v1

name: Snowflake
entity_note: Snowflake SQL API plus Snowflake-managed MCP server; endpoints are per-account URLs.
description: Cloud data platform; SQL API executes statements over REST per account.
needs_human: Production use is inside each customer's own Snowflake account (account-specific URL, OAuth/key-pair setup by customer admin). Trial limitations not reviewed.

evidence.quote: Use OAuth or Key Pair to authenticate with the Snowflake server.
KEYPAIR_JWT (for key-pair authentication) OAUTH (for OAuth) PROGRAMMATIC_ACCESS_TOKEN (for programmatic access tokens )
You can sign up for a free trial using the self-service form
The Snowflake-managed MCP server lets AI agents securely retrieve data from Snowflake accounts without needing to deploy separate infrastructure.
https://<account_url>/api/v2/databases/{database}/schemas/{schema}/mcp-servers/{name}

name: MongoDB Atlas
entity_note: Atlas Administration API (control plane); does not access cluster data.
description: Managed MongoDB cloud; Admin API manages clusters, projects, users and access.
needs_human: Atlas Managed MCP Server is described as public preview; confirm hosted URL and GA status. Remote vs local both official.

evidence.quote: We recommend you use service accounts instead of API keys to authenticate to the Atlas Administration API.
Service account access tokens ( OAuth 2.0) API keys ( HTTP Digest Authentication)
To create a service account or API keys for an organization, you must have Organization Owner access to that organization.
Get started for free in minutes
MongoDB Atlas Managed MCP Server, which MongoDB hosts and manages for you in Atlas.
